## 21. Concessions when posted to North-Eastern Region, etc.  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part - I ]  
Certain special concessions and service benefits are admissible to officers transferred to the North-Eastern Region and Union Territories listed below and to officers posted to North-Eastern Council when they are stationed in the North-Eastern Region. These concessions are also admissible to those on deputation to State Governments of Manipur and Tripura.  
1. Assam 5.  
- Tripura
